{{Quote|The ''Otana'' is a beauty of a ship that I would love to fly!|MK-09|audio=OtanaEmkay1-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
The '''''Otana''''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] used by the [[Azzameen family]]. Originally owned by [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]], the ship was heavily modified to improve its speed and firepower. It eventually became Tomaas's personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]] and was often [[Pilot/Legends|co-piloted]] by his eldest son, [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]]. Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Tomaas entered into negotiations with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to supply them with much needed [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], resulting in the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] being present at the Alliance's [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The ''Otana'' escaped Hoth and Tomaas continued to assist the Alliance, until he and Galin were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack while delivering bacta to the Rebels. After Tomaas's death, the ship passed to his youngest son, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]]. Wanted by the Empire, Ace and his surviving siblings fled their [[Azzameen Station/Legends|home]] and sought sanctuary with the Rebels. Ace soon decided to join the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]], but kept the ''Otana'' as his personal transport. Co-piloted by Ace's [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]], Ace used the ship for several missions, working alongside his brother [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]] and sister [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]].

==Description==
[[File:YT-2000b.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ventral view of the ''Otana'']]
A [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000]], the ''Otana'' was originally designed to serve as a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] and [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]].<ref name="XWA" /> Developed as an evolution to the [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]], the YT-2000 was designed to incorporate and improve on many of the more successful features of its predecessors and was designed to be customizable, with plenty of space and power made available for modifications.<ref name="SotG" /> After the ''Otana'' came into the possession of [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]], the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was modified to further improve some of its features, with notable improvements to speed and firepower.<ref name="XWA" />

The ship was 29 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length,<ref name="XWA" /> with a symmetrical layout, similar to that of the [[YT-1930 transport/Legends|YT-1930]].<ref name="SotG" /> The [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] was located centrally at the front of the ship and could accommodate a crew of two. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] station was at the front of the cockpit, with the co-pilot located directly behind and above him at a raised console. The upper half of the cockpit was constructed of a transparent material, such as [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]], which afforded both pilot and co-pilot clear views to the front, sides and above. The crew quarters provided a simple bunk for sleeping and a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] console, which could be used to receive [[e-mail]].<ref name="XWA" /> In addition to the crew, the ship could carry up to seven passengers. Like all YT-2000's, the ship's cargo space was extensive, with room for 115 tons of cargo and consumables for three [[Standard month/Legends|months]].<ref name="SotG" />

The ''Otana''{{'s}} engines were located at the rear of the ship.<ref name="XWA" /> The basic design could achieve a maximum [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] speed of 800 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]] and was fitted with a Class 2 primary [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and a [[backup hyperdrive]] rated at Class 12. Calculating courses through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] was assisted by the ship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]].<ref name="SotG" /> Modifications undertaken by the [[Azzameen family]] made the ''Otana'' faster than a standard YT-2000, and the ship was ultimately capable of achieving 96 [[Megalight|MGLT]].<ref name="XWA" />

[[File:OtanaHyperspace.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Otana'' travels through hyperspace.]]
In addition to the increased drive systems, the weapons systems onboard were also heavily upgraded.<ref name="XWA" /> The YT-2000 model came fitted with two [[Laser cannon/Legends|double laser cannons]],<ref name="SotG" /> located in turrets on top and underneath the ship,<ref name="XWA" /> which provided total cover of both the dorsal and ventral hemispheres. Though both turrets could be manually operated by gunners, they also had an autofire mode,<ref name="SotG" /> allowing them to track a specific target or lay down defensive fire against attacking ships.<ref name="XWA" /> Following the upgrade to its weapons, the ''Otana'' also had a forward facing laser cannon which could be fired linked with the two turrets. A single forward facing [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] provided the pilot with the ability to disable enemy vessels,<ref name="XWA" /> while the ship could carry a load of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] or other [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] in its twin warhead launchers.<ref name="Warheads" />

The ''Otana''{{'s}} [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shields]], which were rated at 320 [[SBD/Legends|SBD]],<ref name="XWA" /> were heavier than those aboard most civilian freighters.<ref name="SotG" /> Along with a [[Hull/Legends|hull]] rated at 114 [[RU/Legends|RU]], the shields were capable of withstanding most attacks, but the vessel could also carry extra [[Warhead countermeasure|countermeasures]] in the form of [[Chaff/Legends|chaff]],<ref name="XWA" /> a burst of electromagnetic energy used to deflect either warheads or beam weapons.<ref name="XWA manual">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' manual</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
The ''Otana'' was created during a relatively turbulent era in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history and came with more powerful weaponry and shielding than similar freighters.<ref name="SotG" /> The ship came into the possession of Tomaas Azzameen,<ref name="XWA" /> co-founder and head of the [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]] shipping company,<ref name="XWA manual" /> by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="3ABY">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' takes place between the battles of [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]] which places it in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] based on the dates of those events given in ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Due to the potentially dangerous nature of the family business, Azzameen had the ship modified to provide improved speed and firepower to ensure his safety. The ''Otana'' became Azzameen's personal transport, with his eldest son, [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]], serving as co-pilot.<ref name="XWA" />

===Escape from Hoth===
{{Quote|That was way too close for comfort. Thanks for your help.''"<br />"''No problem, ''Otana''.|Tomaas Azzameen thanks his escort during the Battle of Hoth|audio=OtanaTomaas-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
Tomaas Azzameen was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in their [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Rebels were in need of a supply of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] but were reluctant to trade with [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] groups following some previous difficulties in dealing on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="XWA" /> in 3 ABY,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Tomaas entered negotiations to act as a middleman, using his contacts to procure a supply of bacta on the black market and deliver it to the Rebels. The negotiations led Tomaas and Galin to take the ''Otana'' to the Alliance's [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the ice-[[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. While he was still on the planet,<ref name="XWA" /> the Empire's [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], under the command of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], arrived in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] and launched an assault against the Rebel base.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

[[File:OtanaAndISD-XWAcutscene.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''Otana'' escapes from Hoth.]]
The Rebels quickly made preparations to evacuate the base<ref name="ESB" /> and assigned two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] from [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] to escort the ''Otana'' as the Azzameens made their own attempt to leave the planet. Though the ''Otana''{{'s}} escape vector was blocked by two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], the Rebels used Echo Base's ion cannon to temporarily disable one of the vessels, allowing the ''Otana'' to pass. As the freighter approached, however, the Imperials sent [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] to intercept it. The X-wing pilots quickly eliminated the threat, but the ''Otana'' was struck by debris from one of the Imperial fighters before it made the jump to hyperspace.<ref name="XWA" />

The Azzameens had escaped the Hoth system but the TIE debris had damaged the ''Otana''{{'s}} primary [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]] tank, causing it to lose coolant pressure. Though they were in no immediate danger, Tomaas decided to take the ship to the family's [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|Twin Suns Station]] for repairs. Taking precautions to ensure they weren't followed, the Azzameen's arrived in the [[Roccus system]] and Tomaas contacted his brother, [[Antan Azzameen|Antan]], aboard Twin Suns Station, to request emergency repairs. Yet, Antan refused to repair it, believing that the Empire would soon trace the ship to the Azzameens, and that the family had worked too hard to risk getting involved in the war. As a result, the ''Otana'' was forced to limp back to the [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Home Base]] for repairs. Shortly after his return, Tomaas sent his youngest son, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]], and his daughter, [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]], to [[Harlequin Station]] to pick up a supply of coolant for the ''Otana''.<ref name="XWA" />

===Joining the Rebellion===
{{Quote|Emon will be flying his Firespray as usual, while we fly the ''Otana''. Your father is showing tremendous confidence in us by allowing us to take his ship!|MK-09|audio=OtanaEmkay2-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
Despite the narrow escape from Hoth, Tomaas remained determined to supply the Alliance with the bacta they required and made arrangements to collect a shipment from a smuggler group. Tomaas and Galin would be traveling to the rendezvous point aboard the Azzameens' [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Vasudra]]''. Tomaas asked his children to provide an escort&mdash;Aeron was given the ''Otana'' for the mission, while his sons, Ace and [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]], flew the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Sabra]]'' and the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]] ''[[Andrasta]]'' respectively. After reaching the rendezvous, the ''Vasudra'' docked with the smugglers' [[Xiytiar-class heavy transport/Legends|''Xiytiar''-class transport]] [[End Run (Xiytiar-class)|''End Run'']], and the smugglers began pumping the bacta into its tanks. When the smugglers attempted to double cross the Azzameens, the ''Otana''{{'s}} firepower helped to defeat the smugglers' [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigate]] ''[[Loose Cannon]]''. With their gunship lost, the ''End Run''{{'s}} crew agreed to complete the transfer and the Azzameens returned to Home Base with the bacta.<ref name="XWA" />

[[File:AzzameensApproach-XWA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Otana'' arrives at the Alliance Fleet.]]
Tomaas soon arranged to deliver the bacta to the Rebels. He and Galin traveled aboard the ''Vasudra'' to the Rebel [[XQ2 Platform]] [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|''Hospital'']], where many casualties from the Battle of Hoth were receiving treatment. Emon again took the ''Andrasta'' to provide cover, while the ''Otana'' was piloted by Ace, with the [[MK-series maintenance droid]] [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]] acting as co-pilot. However, the transfer was [[Battle of Hospital|interrupted]] by the arrival of Imperial forces led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garreth Holtz/Legends|Garreth Holtz]] aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Corrupter (Imperial-class)|''Corrupter'']]. Ace helped to engage Imperial [[TIE series/Legends|fighters]] with the ''Otana'' while the Rebels began to evacuate. Thanks in part to his efforts, most of the Rebel ships were able to escape, but he was unable to prevent the ''Vasudra'' being caught by the ''Corrupter'' and both Tomaas and Galin were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="XWA" />

The ''Otana'' now became the property of Ace Azzameen. The Empire [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|declared]] the Azzameen family traitors and issued warrants for their arrest. With little time before the Imperials arrived, Antan instructed their employees to flee and set off to collect supplies from a hidden cargo facility. Ace, meanwhile, took the ''Otana'', accompanied by Aeron in the ''Sabra'', to collect some weapons and valuables from Twin Suns Station. Though they were interrupted by the [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Furious (Victory II-class)|''Furious'']], the ''Otana'' was able to hold off the Empire's TIE fighters until Aeron retrieved the supplies. The pair rendezvoused with Emon at Home Base but learned that Antan had been captured by [[Viraxo Industries]], a rival business firm that sought to ruin the Azzameen family's business. With nowhere else to turn, the Azzameen children tracked down the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] and requested shelter with the Rebels.<ref name="XWA" /> While Emon and Aeron set about consolidating the Azzameen assets and establishing a new base of operations, Ace decided to join the Rebels as a starfighter pilot and was assigned to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']]. The ''Otana'' departed with Ace's siblings and MK-09, but frequently returned to the ''Defiance'' so the young pilot could participate in missions for his family when his duties permitted.<ref name="XWA:OSG">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> When aboard the ''Defiance'', Ace was allowed to store the ''Otana'' in the ship's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].<ref name="XWA" />

===Revenge on the Viraxo===
[[File:GeneralAzzameensTrophies-XWA.png|thumb|right|200px|Ace Azzameen's quarters aboard the ''Otana''.]]
When it emerged that Antan was being held captive by [[K'Armyn Viraxo]],<ref name="XWA" /> Emon dispatched MK-09 in the ''Otana'' to pick up Ace from the ''Defiance'' ahead of a [[Rescue of Antan Azzameen|rescue attempt]].<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Emon and Ace traveled to a [[Viraxo Industries (platform)|Viraxo facility]] where Emon fought Viraxo [[Planetary Defender starfighter]]s in the ''Andrasta'' while Ace docked the ''Otana'' to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] so that MK-09 could board it and retrieve Antan. With Antan safely aboard, the ''Otana'' fled the area just as the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Condemnation]]'' arrived to investigate.<ref name="XWA" />

Some time later, Aeron learned of a scavenger [[Mission to the Saila Na system|operation]] to recover a damaged Imperial [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] near the [[Saila Na system/Legends|Saila Na system]]. Hoping to use the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to monitor the [[Viraxo]], Aeron asked Ace to take the ''Otana'' to recover it before the scavengers. By the time the ''Otana'' arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], however, the scavenger operation was already underway. The scavengers moved to attack the ''Otana'', but Ace defeated several [[R-41 Starchaser]]s and the [[Muurian transport]] ''[[Pelican]]'' before collecting the probe and proceeding to his rendezvous with Aeron via [[Tinoon Station]]. The station's customs officers prepared to inspect the ''Otana'', but before they could discover the restricted Imperial property, a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] raiding party arrived in the system. Ace used the [[Skirmish above Tinoon|raid]] as a diversion to jump to hyperspace and returned to the ''Defiance'' after delivering the droid to Aeron.<ref name="XWA" />

Not long after recovering the probe droid, Ace was transferred to the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']]. Shortly after Ace's transfer, Antan's sources informed him that K'Armyn Viraxo would be traveling aboard the [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]] ''[[Highroller]]'' to [[Destreg Spaceport]].<ref name="XWA" /> MK-09 was dispatched in the ''Otana'' to pick up Ace from the ''Liberty'' and bring him to the family's headquarters. After Antan briefed Ace and Emon, the ''Otana'' and ''Andrasta'' intercepted and [[Assassination attempt on K'Armyn Viraxo|ambushed]] the ''Highroller''.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> They soon realized that they had walked into a trap when several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] arrived to collect a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] that Viraxo had placed on the Azzameens. Nevertheless, the ''Otana'' and ''Andrasta'' proved equal to the challenge and both Azzameens escaped after destroying the empty ''Highroller''.<ref name="XWA" />

===Imperial troubles===
{{Quote|<nowiki />''Otana'', this is Aeron! Do you read? Ace, is that you?''"<br />"''We read you Aeron. Did someone call for a ride?''"<br />"''Stow it, Emkay! Get your rusted bolts over here!|Aeron Azzameen contacts MK-09 on the ''Otana'' from Vergesso Base|audio=R040308-10.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
When Aeron learned that [[Vergesso Base]] in the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]] was running low on supplies, she and Ace decided to steal some from the Viraxo [[industrial complex]] [[VXO-33274]]. Taking the ''Otana'' to the [[Bilbringi V]] [[Bilbringi Shipyards|repair yard]], the pair met up with several former Twin Suns employees and headed to the Viraxo facility. The ''Otana'' soon eliminated the base's defenses, allowing [[Juno (cargo ferry group)|Juno]] and [[Lara (group)|Lara]] groups to pick up several [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]]. However, before the Azzameens could depart, the Viraxo [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvette]] ''[[Charybdis]]'' arrived, along with [[Razor-class starfighter|''Razor''-class starfighters]] from [[Gundark Squadron]].<ref name="XWA" /> The Azzameens engaged the Viraxo ships, destroying them all and ensuring that their convoy could escape to hyperspace, although the ''Otana'' sustained significant damage in the process.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Before returning to the ''Liberty'', Ace took the ''Otana'' to Vergesso Base to drop off Aeron.<ref name="XWA" />

[[File:ExecutorXWA1.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Otana'' flies past the ''Executor'' in the Vergesso Asteroids.]]
Soon after, MK-09 in the ''Otana'' received a message from Aeron that Vergesso Base was under [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards|assault]] from the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. The droid quickly took the ship to pick up Ace<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> and the ''Otana'' headed back to the Vergesso Asteroids in the hopes of rescuing Aeron before the Imperials boarded the base. Arriving behind the Imperial forces, Ace navigated the ''Otana'' past the ''Executor'' on a course for Vergesso Base. Fighting their way past TIE/LN starfighters and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], the pair reached and docked with the station. Ace used the ''Otana''{{'s}} dorsal turret to hold off the Imperial fighters until Aeron and some of the base's personnel were safely aboard, before taking the ship safely back to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="XWA" />

Though Aeron had escaped the Imperials, the Azzameens soon found themselves in more trouble when Emon was arrested by the Empire. After learning that Emon was being detained at [[Quesna Base]], the Azzameens, along with family friend [[Dunari]], devised a plan to rescue him. Quesna Base was expecting a delivery of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas, which Dunari's agents were able to intercept and plant a bomb in.<ref name="XWA" /> After Dunari arranged for MK-09 to bring the ''Otana'' to Ace on the ''Liberty'', which was stationed near his [[Casino/Legends|casino]], [[Dunari's Rest]],<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Ace took the ''Otana'' to the [[XQ4 Platform]] [[Stockyard]], where the [[pressure tank]] containing the tibanna was waiting for collection, and took the tank to Quesna Base. Dropping the tank near Quesna Base, Ace took the ''Otana'' to a safe distance before the proximity detonator caused the bomb to explode. The explosion provided a distraction which allowed Dunari's Muurian transport, the ''[[Deadman's Hand]]'', to enter the area and board Quesna Base to rescue Emon. Ace used the ''Otana'' to protect the ''Deadman's Hand'' from Imperial defenders until Emon was safely aboard and both ships returned to Dunari's Rest.<ref name="XWA" />

Emon and Aeron soon concluded that there was a Virazo mole within the Azzameen organization. In order to confirm their suspicions, Aeron wanted to examine the communications logs from Azzameen Home Base's [[Comm Datacore|datacore]], which had been abandoned at an [[Junkyard Control|Imperial junkyard]] after the Azzameens were driven from their home. Ace [[Mission to recover Comm Datacore|took]] the ''Otana'' to the junkyard to locate the datacore, with Emon in the ''Andrasta'' providing support. After locating the cargo container holding the datacore, MK-09 left the ''Otana'' and boarded the container to retrieve it. While MK-09 was getting the core, raiders in [[R60 T-wing interceptor]]s arrived and moved to attack the Azzameens. The ''Otana'' and ''Andrasta'', however, were able to eliminate the threat. Ace retrieved MK-09 and the datacore before taking the ''Otana'' back to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="XWA" />

===Family reunion===
{{Quote|Otana, surrender your ship at once or we will open fire!''"<br />"''That's okay&hellip;we were just leaving.|An [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] and Aeron Azzameen in the Carida system|audio=OtanaAeron-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
Shortly after the Azzameens retrieved the datacore, mercenaries, claiming to work for the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], attacked a meeting between Alliance and [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] leaders. A mercenary captured during the attack soon revealed that the group was striking from a secret base&mdash;though he did not know the coordinates, he informed his captors that the [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] ''[[Redhawk]]'' was due to deliver supplies to the base and would be taking on cargo at a [[Cargo Station|space station]] en route. In an effort to [[Reconnaissance of mercenary base|locate]] the mercenary base, Ace took Aeron to the station aboard the ''Otana'' and docked with the ''Redhawk''. Aeron and MK-09 bypassed the ship's security and Aeron began to download the coordinates of its destination. Nonetheless, their actions attracted the attention of the station's security and Ace used the ''Otana''{{'s}} turret to hold off their [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighters]] until the download was complete and the ''Otana'' could jump to hyperspace.<ref name="XWA" />

[[File:AceHomeBase-dat15210-45-XWA.png|thumb|right|The ''Otana'' assists in the capture of Azzameen Home Base.]]
However, it soon became clear that the Azzameens had been tricked&mdash;instead of arriving at the mercenary base, the ''Otana'' emerged from hyperspace at an Imperial weapons testing range in the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]]. The ship was soon hailed by the Imperials and its crew ordered to stand down ready to be boarded. The Azzameens decided to return to the station and make another attempt to find the mercenary base's location by retrieving the ''Redhawk''{{'s}} course from its computer. The ''Otana'' fled into hyperspace, evading the Imperial starfighters launched against it. After arriving back at the cargo station, the ''Otana'' docked while Aeron [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] the station's computer, again attracting the attention of station security. Evading the station's [[IRD starfighter]]s, the ''Otana'' jumped once more into hyperspace and the Azzameens were shocked when the ship returned to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] at Azzameen Home Base. Realizing that the Viraxo had sold the station to the mercenaries, they quickly returned to the ''Liberty'' with their findings.<ref name="XWA" />

The Alliance hoped to eliminate the mercenaries before they could further damage relationships between the Bothans and the Sullustans. To this end they made plans to [[Battle of Azzameen Station|capture]] Azzameen Home Base, hoping to find evidence showing who was behind the attack in the base's computer. Ace Azzameen was assigned to fly a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] for the operation&mdash;due to the personal nature of the mission, Aeron and Emon accompanied the Rebels aboard the ''Otana'' and the ''Andrasta'' respectively. Emerging from hyperspace, Aeron moved to engage mercenary starfighters while the Rebels attacked the base's static defenses. However, the Azzameens were shocked to see their uncle's [[Big Score|ship]] fleeing the station. Though Antan escaped, the Rebels soon captured the base and Emon departed in search of his uncle.<ref name="XWA" />

It was Antan, however, who made contact with the other Azzameens, requesting a meeting at Azzameen Home Base to explain his actions. Ace and Aeron took the ''Otana'' to the rendezvous, while Emon traveled aboard the ''Andrasta''. Though Antan admitted that he was working for the Empire, and that he was responsible for the attack on the Bothans, he claimed that he was only doing so in an effort to secure the release of Tomaas and Galin, who he had learned were still alive and in Imperial custody. The Azzameens planned to [[Mission to Kessel Station|rescue]] their missing family members and Antan led the group to [[Kessel Station]] where the pair were supposedly being held. The ''Otana'' docked with the base while Aeron attempted to locate her father and brother but, with the arrival of the Star Destroyer [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], the Azzameen children soon realized that Antan had set them up. With their escape route made difficult by their proximity to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], the group prepared to fight, but were rescued by the timely arrival of Dunari, who showed them a safe way out of the area. Evading pursuit by the ''Devastator'', Ace took the ''Otana'' back to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="XWA" />

==Owners and operators==
===Tomaas Azzameen===
[[File:Otana1.png|thumb|right|200px|Tomaas and Galin Azzameen in the ''Otana''{{'s}} cockpit]]
{{Main|Tomaas Azzameen/Legends}}
The head of the Azzameen family, Tomaas founded and operated the family business, Twin Suns Transport Services. His success at turning Twin Suns into a profitable business led the Azzameen family into a bitter rivalry with Viraxo Industries.<ref name="XWA manual" /> Tomaas acquired the ''Otana'' to serve as his personal transport<ref name="XWA" /> by 3 ABY,<ref name="3ABY" /> and had the ship extensively modified to improve speed and firepower. Though not a member of the Rebel Alliance, Tomaas was keen to help the Rebellion by delivering much needed medical supplies, and narrowly escaped the Empire's assault on Hoth during negotiations with the Alliance. He was later killed in an Imperial attack while delivering bacta to the Rebels.<ref name="XWA" />

===Galin Azzameen===
{{Main|Galin Azzameen/Legends}}
Tomaas Azzameen's eldest son, Galin was first in line to inherit the family business from his father and shared his father's affinity for the Rebellion.<ref name="XWA manual" /> Galin served as his father's co-pilot aboard the ''Otana'', and the two traveled together aboard the ship to meet with the Rebels on Hoth. Though Galin escaped the subsequent Imperial attack on Echo Base, he was killed, along with his father, while delivering bacta to the Rebel XQ2 Platform Hospital.<ref name="XWA" />

===Ace Azzameen===
[[File:Ace_and_MK.jpg|thumb|right|Ace Azzameen and MK-09 piloting the ''Otana'']]
{{Quote|Ace was unhappy when Aeron and I arrived in the ''Sabra'' to pick him up. Where is the ''Otana''? I could almost hear him thinking. I was tempted to try a little droid humor on him and say I had wrecked it, but I did not want to risk being shut down.|MK-09|<ref name="XWA:OSG" />}}
{{Main|Ace Azzameen/Legends}}
The youngest child of Tomaas Azzameen, Ace demonstrated a talent for piloting during his early work for the family business. Following the death of his father and Galin, Ace inherited the ''Otana'' and regularly used the ship to conduct family business where permitted by his duties as an Alliance starfighter pilot. Ace went on to become a highly regarded pilot, assisting [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] in the capture of the [[Death Star II plans]], and serving aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="XWA" /> Ace later confided in MK-09 that he wished he had been piloting the ''Otana'' in the battle.<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

===MK-09===
{{Quote|I was thrilled when Emon ordered me to take the ''Otana'' and pick up Ace at the CRS ''Defiance''. For the record, it was not my fault I arrived later than scheduled. I have tolerated the accusations I went on a "joyride" with the ''Otana'' only because I am programmed to absorb verbal abuse. It is true I have what might be termed a "passion" for flying the ''Otana'', but it is not my place to take liberties with it.|MK-09|<ref name="XWA:OSG" />}}
{{Main|MK-09/Legends}}
MK-09, nicknamed Emkay, was a heavily modified [[Kalibac Industries]] MK-series maintenance droid who served the Azzameen family. Among his modifications, MK-09 was capable of piloting and repairing most light to medium vessels and had aggression circuits which made the droid eager to engage in combat.<ref name="XWA manual" /> After the death of Tomaas and Galin, MK-09 became the ''Otana''{{'s}} regular co-pilot, with Ace serving as pilot.<ref name="XWA" /> The droid held the ''Otana'' in high regard and relished the opportunity to fly the ship alone from time to time.<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

===Aeron Azzameen===
{{Main|Aeron Azzameen}}
The only daughter of Tomaas Azzameen, Aeron was a capable hacker who could slice most computer systems.<ref name="XWA manual" /> Though not a regular member of the ''Otana''{{'s}} crew, Aeron did serve aboard the ship on several occasions, and piloted the vessel while escorting her father during his attempts to acquire bacta for the Rebels and again during the capture of Azzameen Home Base by the Alliance.<ref name="XWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Otana'' was created for the [[1999]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', in which it serves as the personal transport of the game's main character, Ace Azzameen. The ship is flyable in several missions throughout the game and some history and specifications for the vessel could be found in the game's tech library.<ref name="XWA" />
